content: Hello! How can I assist you today with your freelance invoice settlements or payment tracking?
Hi, I wanted to check if my payment for invoice #F10287 has been processed. I sent it last Friday via Zelle.

Thanks for following up, Alex. I see invoice F10287 for $950 was logged as paid on June 14th to the clubs Zelle account (treasurer@auroramakers.org). Your Zelle confirmation (Ref: ZL-9934A6) matched perfectly. Need that confirmation for your records?
Yes, please send it over. Also, is my address updated to 327 Maple Lane, Apt 2C, Springfield?

Absolutely, Ill forward the Zelle transaction receipt to alex.jennings@freelancepro.net. And yes, our records now show 327 Maple Lane, Apt 2C, Springfield, IL 62704 as your primary address. All future payments will reference that.
Great, I should be expecting the next payment by the 20th, right?

Thats correctthe next invoice (F10288) for $1,200 is scheduled for payout by June 20th. Please keep an eye on your Zelle account ending in 4182 for notification. If anything seems delayed, let me know immediatelywe want to make sure youre paid on time.
Thanks! My cell is still 217-555-0429 if you need to reach me quickly.
Perfect, 217-555-0429 is the number we have on file for urgent updates. Youll get an SMS alert as soon as the payment is released. Let me know if anything changeswe strive for zero delays!
